versions.content: Communication Management shall provide an interface to sub- scribe to a specific event or trigger provided by an instance of a certain service Description: Application developers shall be able to subscribe to one specific event or trigger inside of one selected service instance. Rationale: After finding instances of a service type, it shall be possible to subscribe to certain events and triggers of a specific instance. Dependencies: – Use Case: Application “A” subscribes to the power on event of the application controlling the ignition lock. Supporting Material: –
